prose:
A Bloomberg item indexed by Techmeme says the National Governors Association proposes dividing AI regulatory responsibilities: federal review of powerful models alongside state-level consumer protection. The excerpt presents a bipartisan appeal to Washington rather than an enacted allocation of authority.

The supplied source URL is Bloomberg's homepage and did not resolve to the article or proposal text. The exact definitions of covered models, state protections, enforcement and preemption remain unknown. This story is kept separate from earlier unrelated Bloomberg-homepage stories, since a shared generic URL does not make their content the same. No law, agreement or change to existing jurisdiction is established by the excerpt.
highlights: Techmeme attributes the proposal to the National Governors Association
Federal review of AI models is one reported component
State consumer protection is the other reported component
A proposal is not enacted law or a completed agreement
The source URL is a generic homepage, not an inspected article
Scope, enforcement and preemption details remain unverified
